name: corbu-ai
description: 유시민 스타일 통합 고급 AI 시스템입니다.

scripts.start: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 BROWSER=none PORT=3000 HOST=0.0.0.0 DANGEROUSLY_DISABLE_HOST_CHECK=true DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true react-scripts start
scripts.start:local: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 BROWSER=none PORT=3000 HOST=127.0.0.1 DANGEROUSLY_DISABLE_HOST_CHECK=true DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true react-scripts start
scripts.test:e2e:pipelines:all: npm run test:e2e:composer-pipeline:all && npm run test:e2e:conversation-graph:chromium
scripts.test:e2e:pipelines:ci:all: npm run test:e2e:composer-pipeline:ci:all && npm run test:e2e:conversation-graph:ci
scripts.start:safe: PORT=3000 HOST=0.0.0.0 NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 BROWSER=none react-scripts start
scripts.pretest: npm run check:test-imports && npm run check:src-frontend-parity
scripts.test:ci: npm run pretest && CI=true react-scripts test --coverage --watchAll=false
scripts.test:all: npm test -- --watchAll=false && npm run test:report && npm run test:quality
scripts.test:jest:jsdom: npm run pretest && CI=true npx jest --env=jsdom --watchAll=false
scripts.test:unified-api: npm run pretest && CI=true npx jest --env=jsdom --watchAll=false src/services/__tests__/unifiedAPI.test.ts src/services/__tests__/modernChatContextBuilder.test.ts src/services/__tests__/generationPromptBuilder.test.ts src/services/__tests__/intelligentKnowledgeProcessor.test.ts src/services/__tests__/enhancedBackendAPI.test.ts src/services/__tests__/enhancedResponseProcessor.test.ts src/services/__tests__/chatService.test.ts src/services/__tests__/integratedMessageService.test.ts src/services/__tests__/unifiedMessageService.test.ts src/services/__tests__/integratedSystemAPI.test.ts src/services/__tests__/messageResponseAPI.test.ts
scripts.test:chat-api: npm run pretest && CI=true npx jest --env=jsdom --watchAll=false src/config/__tests__/api.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/apiClient.test.ts src/utils/__tests__/streamingClient.test.ts src/services/__tests__/chatService.test.ts src/services/__tests__/unifiedAPI.test.ts src/services/__tests__/integratedMessageService.test.ts src/services/__tests__/unifiedMessageService.test.ts src/services/__tests__/integratedSystemAPI.test.ts src/services/__tests__/messageResponseAPI.test.ts src/hooks/__tests__/useAIEngine.test.ts
scripts.test:chat-api:all: npm run test:chat-api && npm run test:chat-api:frontend
scripts.test:unified-api:all: npm run test:unified-api && npm run test:unified-api --prefix frontend
scripts.test:frontend:chat-pipeline: npm run pretest && CI=true react-scripts test --testPathPattern='chatInputUtils|streamingClient|generationPromptBuilder|GensparkPipelineExtrasPanel|GensparkAgentsHubView|modernChatContextBuilder|modernChatGensparkSearchParams|gensparkAgentRegistry|fileAnalysisChatContextMerge|integratedMasterChatContextMerge|ultimateChatContextMerge|chatGptComposerPayload\.test|AppUnified\.test|config/__tests__/routes\.test|chatService|integratedSystemAPI|enhancedBackendAPI|multiStepResponseGenerator|unifiedAPI\.test' --watchAll=false
scripts.sync:frontend-chat-input-utils: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/utils/chatInputUtils.ts','frontend/src/utils/chatInputUtils.ts'); console.log('synced src/utils/chatInputUtils.ts -> frontend/src/utils/chatInputUtils.ts');" && npm run pretest
scripts.test:dev:dual-pipeline: npm run test:backend:pipeline-smoke && npm run test:frontend:chat-pipeline
scripts.deploy:check: npm run verify:completion && npm run build
scripts.deploy:server: npm run deploy:check && npm run deploy:dev
scripts.typecheck:adaptive-learning-tests:all: npm run typecheck:adaptive-learning-tests && npm run typecheck:adaptive-learning-tests --prefix frontend
scripts.test:adaptive-learning: npm run pretest && CI=true react-scripts test --testPathPattern=adaptiveLearningEngine --watchAll=false
scripts.test:e2e:chat-multi-request-checklist: E2E_CHAT_MULTI_REQUEST_CHECKLIST=1 E2E_SERVER_READY=1 playwright test e2e/chat.spec.ts -g "다중 요청" --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:composer-pipeline:all: npm run test:e2e:composer-pipeline && npm run test:e2e:chat-multi-request-checklist && npm run test:e2e:composer-regenerate
scripts.test:e2e:composer-pipeline:ci:all: npm run test:e2e:composer-pipeline:ci && npm run test:e2e:chat-multi-request-checklist:ci && npm run test:e2e:composer-regenerate:ci
scripts.test:e2e:composer-regenerate: E2E_COMPOSER_REGENERATE=1 E2E_SERVER_READY=1 playwright test e2e/composerRegenerateNonStream.spec.ts e2e/composerRegenerateStream.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:build: npm run build && E2E_USE_BUILD=1 playwright test
scripts.test:tts:all: npm test -- --testPathPattern="AdvancedFeaturesPanel|scriptStyleAPI|qwenTtsService" --watchAll=false && (cd backend && (if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_tts_api.py -v; elif [ -x venv/bin/python ]; then venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_tts_api.py -v; else python3 -m pytest tests/test_tts_api.py -v; fi))
scripts.test:conversation-graph: npm run pretest && CI=true react-scripts test --testPathPattern='conversationGraph|ConversationGraphView|ConversationGraphAnswer|generateGraphAnswer|conversationGraphTestIds|kakaoTalk' --watchAll=false
scripts.verify:conversation-graph:unit: npm run typecheck:views-tests && npm run test:conversation-graph && npm run test:backend:conversation-graph
scripts.verify:conversation-graph:local: npm run verify:conversation-graph:unit && npm run verify:conversation-graph-api
scripts.verify:conversation-graph: npm run verify:conversation-graph:unit && npm run test:e2e:conversation-graph:chromium
scripts.test:conversation-graph:chat-handoff: npm run pretest && CI=true react-scripts test --testPathPattern='conversationGraphChatContextEnhancer|conversationGraphHandoff|ChatGPTInterface.test' --testNamePattern='handoff|관계도' --watchAll=false
scripts.verify:project-sources: npm test -- --testPathPattern="projectService.test|ChatGPTInterface.test" --watchAll=false && npm run test:backend -- tests/test_project_session_api.py::TestProjectAPI::test_upload_project_file -q && E2E_SERVER_READY=1 playwright test e2e/projectManagement.spec.ts -g "소스 탭에서" --project=chromium
scripts.test:app-unified: npm run pretest && CI=true react-scripts test --testPathPattern=AppUnified.test --watchAll=false
scripts.test:views: npm run pretest && react-scripts test src/views src/config/__tests__/routes.test.ts --watchAll=false
scripts.perf:analyze: npm run build && npm run analyze:bundle
